relationships.subject: ion channel gene variants
relationships.evidence_quote: Patients with ICG variants reported more severe pain compared to patients without such variants

key_findings: 4.8% of 414 SFN patients carried potentially pathogenic variants in ion channel genes, most frequently in TRP genes (TRPA1, TRPM8, TRPV1, TRPV3).
Patients with ICG variants reported higher maximal pain (VAS 9.36 vs 7.47); all variants were VUS.
